snippet.title: Record Store Nightmare Trailer
snippet.description: The dead have risen...and they want music! Help Rob defend the record store from the undead. But you're still on the clock, so keep putting away those records! This PC game is inspired by Tapper, and supports speed run and endless run modes. Available here: https://hotseatgames.itch.io/record-store-nightmare
